summary: Casella Waste Systems filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing the pricing of a remarketing of $15M aggregate principal amount of New York State Environmental Facilities Corporation Solid Waste Disposal Revenue Bonds (Series 2014R-2). The bonds, originally issued in 2014, are subject to mandatory tender on June 1, 2026, and will be remarketed at 4.300% per annum for a new ten-year interest rate period ending June 1, 2036. This is a routine refinancing of existing tax-exempt debt. There is no equity event, no change of control, and no special-situation catalyst. The filing reflects ordinary-course liability management and does not qualify as a special situation.
